verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features (Seer, Autofix, AI code review), so a training opt-out is a fair question. The evidence pack has no documented setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Self-hosting is a different deployment choice, not a training opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
